custom_dep (x86_64-custom, lib) features=[] deps=[]
host64_dep (host, lib) features=[] deps=[]
none_dep (x86_64-custom, lib) features=[] deps=[]
plat@build-script (host, build-script) features=[] deps=[host64_dep -> host64_dep]
plat (x86_64-custom, lib) features=[] deps=[custom_dep -> custom_dep, none_dep -> none_dep] runs=plat@build-script
